'''Fan sites''' are independent websites that published Star Wars CCG decks, strategy, interviews, squadron tables, and regional news during the Decipher years and after. This wiki is the reading copy of those lists; the historical hosts stay in Sources.

[[Decklists]] collates the published 60s. Championship sheets stay on their event hubs.

== Related official outlets ==

[[Radio Free Decipher]] was Decipher's weekly audio show. Squadron call-ins on that show overlap the CEC [[Squadron Members]] roster.
